card.name: Words that expect "with" next
card.fires_on: A word that normally takes the preposition "with" right after it, such as reconcile, border, alignment, correspondence, relations or tensions. It is used in general prose about relationships, agreement or conflict.

modes.label: Relation nouns
modes.description: A noun of relationship or connection, followed by "with" and the other party.
modes.example: poor<< relations>> with the other generals on his staff.

modes.label: Agreement or conflict verbs
modes.description: A verb or adverb about fitting or clashing, followed by "with".
modes.example: conflicts<< directly>> with the goal of ensuring that all Americans

modes.label: Border and alignment nouns
modes.description: A noun of closeness or matching, followed by "with".
modes.example: close to the<< border>> with Italy.

card.writes: It promotes the word "with" (and its equivalents in other languages) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on words that are almost always followed by "with", like "relations" or "in agreement".
